observations.observation: The compact native Create HOC dialog derives RR and recommends disjoint two-stage for two measurement-only dimensions.
Canvas shows the edited HOC, its two dimensions, and one authored HOC-to-outcome structural path; membership is a visual overlay only.
Calculate keeps the 18-method catalogue and exposes one compact RR disjoint-two-stage HOC route row under PLS-SEM Algorithm.
The packaged HOC calculation is monitored through the native advanced-calculation progress surface.
The completed HOC calculation opens categorized Results with researcher-facing component relationships and retained canonical identity.
A newly launched packaged process reopens the saved archive and restores the same canonical HOC Results identity.
